why_preregistered: The design is fixed now, before any compute is spent, for the same reason ODYSSEY_PROMOTION_GATE.md was written before its decision went live: a gate designed after seeing results is a gate shaped by them. No packing runs tonight. When a heavy window opens, this file says what to run and what would count as failure, and it is not editable after the fact without saying so.
the_question: Math-Preserve at 0.9774 BPW is semantically collapsed. R0 failed at 0.883 and again at 0.921 with lm_head and embed_tokens protected. Is there a materially different SUB-BIT representation of this parent that generates, or is sub-bit itself the wall for GLM-5.2?

governing_law.rule: representation-before-BPW. A stronger representation family must be tried at sub-bit before any BPW escalation. Escape above one complete BPW additionally requires a sealed Escape Receipt.
refused_evidence: f1_only -- F1 weight reconstruction is NOT capability proof
scheduler_deferred -- scheduler deferral is not scientific collapse
governing_law.implication_for_this_tournament: Weight-space reconstruction error is NOT an admissible outcome measure here. Every arm is judged on generation, not on how well it reproduces parent weights. This is the specific mistake the law names, and it is the one a compression tournament naturally drifts toward.

materially_different.definition: Two arms are materially different only if they differ in what the representation CAN express, not in how its parameters were fitted. Retuning ranks, codebook sizes or ridge terms within one family is one arm, not several.
materially_different.why_this_matters: The campaign has already spent pilots on ladder rungs of one family and reached R0_IS_THE_PRACTICAL_CEILING. Repeating that with different constants would burn a heavy window to re-derive a known answer.

arms.name: native functional expert replacement
arms.expresses: each routed expert replaced by a fitted function of the input rather than a compressed weight matrix
arms.why_it_could_differ: routed experts carry ~97.5 percent of the mass. If the failure is expert reconstruction rather than global rate, replacing the expert's FUNCTION rather than its WEIGHTS changes what is being preserved.
arms.prior: GLM52_FUNCTIONAL_CPU_PARITY.json exists and the codec glm52.functional.moe.v1 is already frozen and deterministic. The cascade study found the student diverges by L4-8 across all 40 layers via router drift, so this arm must be judged end to end, never per-layer.

arms.name: PQ plus learned residual correction
arms.expresses: quantized base plus an explicitly fitted correction term on the residual
arms.why_it_could_differ: adds a second, differently-shaped error budget rather than a finer version of the first

arms.name: additive / multi-codebook representation
arms.expresses: sum of several coarse codebooks instead of one fine codebook
arms.why_it_could_differ: different rate-distortion geometry at the same total bits; failure modes are additive rather than concentrated

arms.name: shared latent expert basis with causal gates
arms.expresses: experts as gated combinations of a shared basis
arms.why_it_could_differ: exploits inter-expert redundancy, which per-expert compression cannot see at all

arms.name: profile-conditioned protected islands
arms.expresses: protection allocated by measured causal importance to the math profile rather than by tensor role
arms.why_it_could_differ: Math-Preserve already spends 67.5 GB on protected islands and still collapses, so the question is whether the islands are in the wrong PLACES, not whether there are too few

arms.name: trajectory-stabilized hybrid
arms.expresses: representation fitted against multi-layer trajectory preservation rather than per-tensor error
arms.why_it_could_differ: directly targets the router-drift compounding the cascade study identified as the failure mechanism
arms.dependency: needs full-sequence parent trajectory traces. The teacher ledger has 122 lines, 118 per-layer captures over synthetic probes and 0 trajectory traces, so this arm is DATA-BLOCKED until traces exist. Do not silently substitute per-layer organs.

physical_ceiling.measured_as: complete BPW over the whole model as an exact rational, the same accounting as GLM52_H0_98_MATH_PRESERVE_RECEIPT.json, including packaging, metadata, codebooks, runtime tables and protected islands
physical_ceiling.no_exclusions: no modeled-zero, no payload-only, no per-tensor exemption. The ceiling is the same one the sealed receipt used, so results are comparable to Math-Preserve's 0.9774.

pilot_scope.layers: a fixed contiguous window plus a fixed sampled window, chosen ONCE and identical across arms
pilot_scope.why_two_windows: a contiguous window measures cascade; a sampled window measures whether damage is local. An arm that passes one and fails the other is informative rather than confusing.

nulls.name: uniform-rate control
nulls.purpose: the same bit budget spent uniformly. An arm that does not beat this has not demonstrated its structure matters.

nulls.name: random-policy control
nulls.purpose: the same budget allocated at random. Guards against a result that is really just 'more bits somewhere'.

nulls.name: constant-mean null for any cosine-style metric
nulls.purpose: raw activation cosine on this parent has a constant-mean null of 0.898. Any similarity metric must be reported against its own null or it is uninterpretable.

G_live.name: live-generation gate
G_live.test: greedy continuation from the artifact over HTTP or the attribution instrument
G_live.pass: output is semantically appropriate to the prompt
G_live.fail: confidently wrong, or constant across prompts
G_live.note: this is the gate Math-Preserve fails and no earlier gate caught

G_math.name: 2 + 2 gate
G_math.why: the cheapest possible probe inside the profile the artifact claims to preserve. If this fails nothing else needs measuring.

G_parity.name: oracle/runtime parity
G_parity.test: numpy oracle over the same container and codec vs Rust/Metal on identical token ids
G_parity.pass: argmax and top-5 match in exact order
G_parity.why: keeps the runtime exonerated, so any failure is attributable to the representation. Without it a bad result is ambiguous.

G_cascade.name: full-cascade gate
G_cascade.test: the pilot windows composed end to end, not judged per layer
G_cascade.why: the cascade study found students diverge by L4-8 in all 40 layers through router drift. Per-layer success has already been shown not to compose.

G_halo.name: support halo
G_halo.when: only after G_live and G_math pass. Running it against a collapsed artifact wastes hours at 0.4 tok/s and produces a floor score that would poison later regression measurement.

kill_conditions: G_math fails -> arm dead, no further compute, record and stop
G_parity fails -> STOP EVERYTHING: the runtime is implicated and no representation conclusion can be drawn until that is resolved
arm does not beat N1 or N2 -> arm dead, its structure is not doing work
arm cannot be expressed under 1.0 complete BPW at pilot scope -> arm is not a sub-bit result and moves to the escape question
A6 with no trajectory traces -> DATA_BLOCKED, not FAILED. Do not run it on substitute data and report the result.

the_later_decision_rule.if_every_materially_different_sub_bit_fa: then and only then consider a SEPARATELY VERSIONED parity artifact up to 1.5 BPW, under a sealed Escape Receipt.
the_later_decision_rule.do_not_weaken: the strict sub-bit Frontier contract. A parity artifact above one BPW is a different, separately versioned product line. It is not a relaxation of the frontier, and the frontier's ceiling stays at 1.0.
the_later_decision_rule.what_the_escape_receipt_would_cite: this tournament's negative results plus GRAVITY_DEGENERATE_ATTRIBUTION.json. That is a live generation failure on a real flagship confirmed by oracle -- the category of evidence the law demands, and neither of the two substitutes it names and refuses.
the_later_decision_rule.who_decides: the user. This is a governance decision, not a technical one, and it is recorded here rather than taken.

resource_note: Nothing in this file runs under HAWKING_RESOURCE_MODE=LIGHT_ONLY. Every arm needs a heavy window. The preregistration is the work that can be done without one, and doing it now is what stops the heavy window being spent on a design argument.
